rawContent: This, coupled with limited natural brush burns, creates the perfect environment for massive-scale fires. By the way, this is not #climatechange or #ClimateCrisis related - it’s a natural burn that eucalyptus goes through once every 20 or so years once the sap builds up enough.

This should be a lesson in how to handle #climatechange in a calculated, analytical, scientific matter instead of in a short-sighted, emotional, reactionary manner. Doing the latter will only cause more harm than good in the long run.
